_comment: The only two ways to reach the demos, and the only place either is written. build.py reads this file; no page, partial or script contains a phone number or a wa.me link. whatsapp.url is the link the site has always used, pre-filled text included; its label is the wording of every WhatsApp link on the site. ivrLine is voice only: never offer WhatsApp or SMS on it. ivrLine.tip and ivrLine.indiaTip are the two tooltips of the split phone pill (footer, Work page, Missed Lead Responder case study).

ivrLine.tip: Call to try our IVR and missed-call responder.
ivrLine.indiaTip: Calling from India needs international calling enabled on your SIM.
